name: Clamlette Surprise
label: Quest
description: Clamlette Surprise: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ever heard of a clamlette? Of course you haven't! It's my latest and greatest culinary masterpiece. Oh, friend, just thinking about a clamlette makes my mouth water.

Unfortunately, I'm all out of supplies to make any! How about I make you a deal? You gather the supplies I need to make a clamlette and I'll teach you the finer points of exotic cuisine and I'll even throw in a couple of clamlettes to boot! Deal??

clips.title: Progress
paras: My cravings are going to be the end of me! Hurry, friend - before I dip into my own supply.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You are in for a special treat, friend. Watch and learn!
